title: Glimpse of Central Japan | Group Tour Package
highlights: Visit the beautiful Imperial Palace in Tokyo and immerse yourself in the rich history and culture of Japan as you marvel at its architectural grandeur.
Stroll through the Arashiyama District, where the lush bamboo groves surround you and offer a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.
Get a glimpse of scenic Japan as you explore, from the bustling streets of Tokyo to the serene temples of Kyoto.
Watch stunning panoramic views and intense volcanic activity closely as you explore Owakudani Valley, with its breathtaking Mount Fuji views.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard
Please do not litter and keep the destination clean.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo, Japan's bustling capital! Upon arrival at the airport, board your transfer and get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, relax for some time, and in the evening, get transferred to Tokyo Station and enjoy a metro ride (tickets included) to the lively Shinjuku district. Upon reaching, soak-in Shinjuku's vibrant energy. You can also enjoy Golden Gai's eclectic nightlife and stroll through Shinjuku Gyoen, a renowned park. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for an amazing Tokyo sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the Zojoji Temple and witness its traditional architecture. Next, pay your respects at the famous Meiji Shrine and drive through the bustling Omotesando area. Continue to the grand Imperial Palace for its stunning architecture and admire the iconic Nijubashi Bridge. Explore the vibrant Akihabara district and other notable landmarks before getting driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kawaguchiko | Visit to Arakurayama Sengen Park and Shrine | Kawaguchi Lake Boat Ride | Trip to Mt. Fuji-5th Station
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred to Kawaguchiko. Upon arrival, you’ll be taken to visit the Arakurayama Sengen Park, renowned for its pagodas and views of Mount Fuji. Next, admire the traditional architecture of Fuji Sengen Shrine, followed by a serene boat ride on Kawaguchi Lake with the reflections of Mount Fuji. Lastly, ascend Mt. Fuji's fifth station and soak-in the views of the iconic mountain. Later, get driven to your hotel in Kawaguchiko for check-in and an overnight stay.

items.title: Visit to Arakurayama Sengen Park and Sengen Shrine

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Visit to Iyashi no Sato Nenba, Shiraito Falls & Toyota Museum
days.desc: Today, after check-out, get transferred to Kyoto, known as the City of Ten Thousand Shrines. En route, make a stop to visit Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a village turned into a museum, featuring traditional thatched-roof houses and cultural exhibits. Next, continue to the picturesque Shiraito Falls and soak-in the views of Mount Fuji. Also, explore the Toyota Museum to discover innovations in automotive technology. Later, upon arriving in Kyoto, check in at your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time in Gion
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer and enjoy a sightseeing tour of Kyoto. Begin by exploring Arashiyama and crossing the scenic Togetsukyo Bridge, a historic structure. Continue with a visit to a UNESCO-listed site Tenryuji Temple, and admire the vibrant torii gates of Fushimi Inari Shrine. Admire the traditional architecture of the Imperial Palace and Kinkakuji Temple. Post-tour, get driven to Gion, where you can visit Kenninji Temple and Yasaka Shrine. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel, marking the end of your amazing trip!
